subject: Deployment Annex: license boundary, operator access & audit path (AtlasCare)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@atlascare.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment Annex: license boundary, operator access & audit path (AtlasCare)

Rachel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our current MSA with the lightweight deployment annex (MSA_v3_redlines.pdf). We pulled together the redlines we expect will address AtlasCare's requirements for an on-prem/VPC deployment while keeping the operator/access model practical:

- License boundary: clarifies run-time-only license for model inference and excludes customer data and derivative IP claims.
- Operator access: suggested time-limited witness window + read-only forensic snapshot delivery instead of persistent operator shells.
- Audit/escrow-like request: proposal for periodic sealed snapshot deposit and mutually agreed witness testing.

Two asks for this thread so we can move to legal redlines: 1) Can you confirm whether AtlasCare requires a monthly snapshot deposit or only event-driven witnessing (e.g., upon termination)? 2) Are there any regulator-driven constraints (e.g., data residency or special evidence handling) beyond the standard HIPAA-style controls we discussed?

I've cc'd David and Connor to chime in on the technical/ops language. If it's helpful we can run a 30-min legal + infra sync on Thurs — propose 10:00 PT.

Attachments: [attachment: MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (pdf, 212KB)]

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@atlascare.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment Annex: license boundary, operator access & audit path (AtlasCare)

Sofia —

Thanks, received. Quick answers up front: AtlasCare's GC is asking for both a periodic evidence deposit (quarterly) and a termination-triggered witness. We also have a requirement to keep forensic artifacts in our cloud region (us-west-2) and to have KMS keys under our control where possible.

A few notes after reviewing your redlines (high level):
- The "time-limited witness" approach looks promising, but GC wants explicit language that the witness cannot perform live administrative actions on our environment.
- Procurement will need clearer language in the Order Form about subscription caps, overage handling, and a billing credit if downtime occurs during a witness.
- For the custody/escrow-like ask: can Redwood provide a technical runbook or an outline of the snapshot creation + sealing process? We need that to evaluate the forensics chain of custody.

I've attached AtlasCare's suggested Order Form updates (OrderForm_AtlasCare_v2.docx) — you will see we added a new Exhibit X that calls out quarterly sealed snapshot and a 48-hour witness window on reasonable notice.

We can do Thurs 10:00 PT for a 30-min call if David/legal can join.

Attachments: [attachment: OrderForm_AtlasCare_v2.docx (docx, 98KB)]

Regards,
Rachel Lee
Head of IT Governance
AtlasCare Systems

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@atlascare.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Deployment Annex: license boundary, operator access & audit path (AtlasCare)

Rachel / Sofia —

Appreciate the clear notes, Rachel. Quick technical/legal alignment from our side and a proposed compromise clause to keep things operationally sound.

1) Snapshot cadence: Redwood is comfortable with quarterly sealed snapshot deposits (we encrypt with a customer-provided KMS key, keep the cryptographic seal, and store in the region you request). For termination-triggered witness we propose a 14-day notice period to schedule a remote witness session; during the session Redwood will supply a read-only forensic snapshot and allow guided reproduction steps.

2) Operator access constraints: we will not accept persistent or interactive admin sessions into AtlasCare VPC. Any on-demand investigative work will be performed against sealed, read-only artifacts or in a customer-provided staging environment. We can add the following clause to the annex: 

--- PROPOSED CLAUSE START ---
Operator Witness and Evidence Handling: Redwood will provide periodic sealed forensic snapshots (quarterly) and, upon termination or a mutually agreed investigation, will make available sealed artifacts for a time-limited witness. Redwood personnel will not be granted persistent interactive administrative access to AtlasCare production environments; any investigative activities will be performed on read-only artifacts or in a customer-controlled staging environment. Custody of encryption keys will remain with AtlasCare unless otherwise agreed in writing.
--- PROPOSED CLAUSE END ---

3) Runbook & test plan: attached is an outline of the operator-runbook we are prepared to share with legal/infra (operator-runbook-outline.pdf). The runbook includes: snapshot creation steps, cryptographic sealing, upload & retention policy, and witness session checklist.

4) Procurement items: Connor will follow up on Order Form language for credits and overage treatment.

If the above looks acceptable we suggest a short legal redline session Thurs 10:00 PT. Otherwise propose two alternatives: Wed 11:00 PT or Fri 09:00 PT.

Attachments: [attachment: operator-runbook-outline.pdf (pdf, 45KB)]

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Product Security (Legal Liaison)
Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
